summary.value: The reviewers suggested that the contributions of this paper are good. They appreciate the new accelerated adaptive method with the ability to adapt to the local curvature of the objective function. The theoretical work is strong.

reviewer_concerns.value:
Some reviewers suggested that small experiments would make the contributions more solid. The authors replied that they would include some preliminary experiments in the revision. Please add them for the publication. 

One reviewer suggested that the author include the discussion about Li & Lan (2025) to the paper. In addition, some reviewers asked about the proof's intuition, and the authors added a sketch of the proof to clarify. Please include the proof sketch in the revision for publication.

reviewer_scores.value: One reviewer replied in the discussion. The initial scores are already good, so I think the final scores would remain the same.
